deep.reconstruction:
This page contains no mathematics. It is the first printed page (page number '1') of the official Berlin lecture catalogue. Its title reads: 'Verzeichniß der Vorlesungen, welche von der Friedrich-Wilhelms-Universität zu Berlin im Sommerhalbenjahre vom 12. April bis zum 14. August 1847 gehalten werden.' It begins with the section 'Gottesgelahrtheit' (theology).

The page lists courses of the theological faculty, each with lecturer, weekly hours, time slot and fee status (privatim, öffentlich, privatissime, unentgeltlich). The lecturers include Hengstenberg, Uhlemann, Benary, Schlottmann, Vatke, Petermann, Erbkam, Twesten, Neander, Jacobi, Chlebus, Piper, Reuter and Strauß. The following page continues with 'Rechtsgelahrtheit' (law).

The only non-printed element is a later archival pencil note, 'Riemann 2', at the top left. There may also be a faint pencil mark ('2'?) in the right margin near the entry 'Der Kirchengeschichte zweiten Theil'. This is uncertain and may be show-through or staining rather than an annotation by Riemann.

Historical context: Riemann matriculated at Göttingen in 1846, nominally in theology/philology, and switched to mathematics. He moved to Berlin for the summer semester of 1847 and stayed until 1849, hearing Dirichlet, Jacobi, Steiner and Eisenstein. This catalogue is therefore almost certainly the one he used when choosing his first Berlin courses. Its value is biographical. The mathematics courses he attended would appear in the philosophical-faculty section on later pages, not on this theology page.

There are no derivations to reconstruct.

results.what: Printed Berlin University lecture catalogue, summer semester 1847, theology section (no mathematical content)

deep.surprise_reason: This is a printed, non-mathematical university course catalogue. That Riemann kept the catalogue for the semester he arrived in Berlin (summer 1847) is consistent with his well-documented biography. Nothing mathematical is present.

checkable.asserts: The stated semester span, 12 April to 14 August 1847, is 124 days.
12 April 1847, the semester start, was a Monday.
14 August 1847, the semester end, was a Saturday (Sonnabend).

transcription_corrections: The print uses the long-s ligature 'ſs' rather than 'ß', e.g. 'Verzeichniſs', 'Entwicklungsproceſs', 'Strauſs'. The transcription normalizes these to 'ß'.
In the Petermann entry the line 'und Interpretiren Dienstags, Donnerstags und' is partly obscured or cut by a fold in the image. The reading given is plausible but not fully legible.
'Riemann 2' at the top left is a handwritten (pencil) archival annotation, not part of the printed text.
A possible faint pencil mark ('2'?) in the right margin beside 'Der Kirchengeschichte zweiten Theil' is not recorded in the transcription. It is uncertain whether it is a deliberate annotation.
